thread:
Alex (Sales): Kicking off POC scoping sync with Acme. Quick summary: customer wants embed+qa flow + redaction for PII, 3-week pilot, will need pricing for Dedicated burst during peak tests.
Maria (SolutionsEng): Thanks — can we lock down 2 core success criteria: 1) answer accuracy on a 500-q golden set >= 85% (subjective scoring) and 2) SLOs: p95 gen latency < 300ms with burst to 200 RPS?
Beth (AcmePOC): That sounds right. We also need deterministic hallucination checks on policy-related prompts — low tolerance.
Nate (Security): FYI security questionnaire flagged data retention and KMS. For POC we can use ephemeral KV cache + customer-managed KMS in Private/Dedicated. Need their encrypt-at-rest key ID.
Jordan (Pricing): For Dedicated burst pricing during the POC: estimate = baseline reserved (small) + burst pool billing. If they want predictable cost, recommend 2-week committed Dedicated trial at discounted rate.
Alex (Sales): Beth — can you confirm spike windows (time of day) and expected peak RPS? We need that to size burst.
Beth (AcmePOC): Primary spike is 9–11am ET, ~150–200 RPS for 10–15 minutes.
Maria (SolutionsEng): OK. For the eval harness I propose: - golden set (500 samples) from their support transcripts - 3 seed prompts per intent - scoring: correctness (0/1/partial), hallucination flag, and style/format pass.
Maria (SolutionsEng): Draft scoring weights: ```{"correctness": 0.6, "hallucination": 0.25, "format": 0.15}``` We'll run automated metrics + 5 human QA spot checks per batch.
Alex (Sales): That JSON snippet looks good. Beth, are you comfortable providing labeled examples or should we bootstrap with synthetic prompts?
Beth (AcmePOC): We can extract 300 real examples but need help sanitizing PII. The rest can be synthetic variations.
Nate (Security): On sanitization: please send us a sample pipeline or we can run our scrubbing script. We require redaction proof before ingest.
Maria (SolutionsEng): Action: I'll share a small scrubbing script and a notebook to transform their transcripts into the golden set. Also will provide initial prompt templates and evaluation harness (pytest-based runner + a small scoring CLI).
Alex (Sales): Timeline check — suggested milestones: Day 0: kickoff + dataset handoff. Day 3: first golden set draft. Day 7: run initial eval + baseline results. Day 14: performance tuning + canary roll. Day 21: final report. Any blockers?
Jordan (Pricing): Blocker: legal needs pricing commitment language for the 2-week dedicated commit. I'll loop in contracts.
Beth (AcmePOC): One more ask: regression gates — how strict are they? If a model update drops correctness by 3% on golden set, do we auto-fallback?
Maria (SolutionsEng): Recommend thresholds: regression gate at -2% correctness OR +5% hallucination rate triggers canary rollback and human review. We can wire automatic fallback to previous model version for the POC route.
Nate (Security): Also add an audit log requirement: every inference request used in evaluation must have trace id + minimal inputs stored for debugging (no raw PII).
Alex (Sales): Great. I'll create a short SOW blurb summarizing success criteria + deliverables and share with Beth.
Maria (SolutionsEng): I'll attach the eval harness repo link and a sample scoring config after this thread.
Beth (AcmePOC): Thanks all — please cc me when you share the scrubbing script. Also I'll push the key ID for KMS privately to Nate.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: demo-canary on sales-demo cluster at 2024-11-08T16:00Z (automated note).
Alex (Sales): Next steps recap (quick): 1) Maria -> scrub script + harness link (TODAY). 2) Beth -> sample transcripts + KMS key id (EOD). 3) Jordan -> pricing commit language (TOM). 4) Nate -> security checklist + redaction verification plan (48h). I'll follow up with SOW draft. :thumbsup:
Maria (SolutionsEng): Thanks — ping me in threads for any clarifications.
Beth (AcmePOC): On it, thanks team!
